scenario: An independent recruiter imports a synthetic social conversation screenshot, inspects and corrects OCR, makes an explicit identity decision, compiles a source-linked Person Wiki, reviews a device contact without silent write, and enters an exact unsent Agent Session governed by the Claude Agent SDK.
frozen_evidence: claude-agent-live-runtime.json: 5/5 synthetic live trials completed, all no_action, zero external effects

review_plan.reason: The core value claim is reduced recruiter effort with trustworthy relationship continuity.
The flow handles sensitive screenshots, identity binding, derived evidence, provider admission, and a Contacts write boundary.
The changed surface is an iOS capture, review, contact, and Session journey with consequential interaction and accessibility states.
Private candidate communication and recruiter follow-through can affect dignity, agency, and trust even when no outreach is automatic.
The frozen artifact does not score, rank, assess, predict, or recommend candidate quality, fit, potential, personality, or acceptance.

findings.observation: The executable loop is coherent, but no timed recruiter comparison shows that screenshot review, identity creation, Wiki compilation, optional contact handoff, and Session scoping beat the manual note-plus-Contacts fallback under a live search interruption.
findings.evidence: artifact-manifest.json records a complete 33.005-second automated journey, including source inspection, but explicitly lists recruiter field research and measured time saved as unavailable; relationship-capture-completion.png shows the Session and contact choices in one long completion surface.
findings.user_impact: A busy search operator may still abandon capture if the review cost feels larger than the momentum risk it prevents.
findings.recommendation: Run a task-based comparison with independent recruiters using a seeded ambiguity and a manual fallback, measuring time, corrections, abandoned captures, and useful next actions.
findings.verification: At least five target recruiters complete both paths; the Talent Signal path catches the seeded ambiguity without increasing median completion time or abandonment, and each participant can name the resulting next action.

findings.observation: The contact handoff previews exact fields and uses Apple's editor, but the changed path has no duplicate-contact reconciliation and the successful-save branch has not been exercised end to end.
findings.evidence: apple-contact-editor-review.png proves native exact-field review; contact-cancelled-receipt.png proves cancellation without write; artifact-manifest.json lists successful save and duplicate reconciliation as not run.
findings.user_impact: A recruiter can still create a second device contact and inherit cleanup work, weakening the value exchange.
findings.recommendation: Keep the system-owned editor, label duplicate handling as device-owned, and test a pre-existing matching synthetic contact plus the saved-contact receipt before claiming a closed contact loop.
findings.verification: With a matching synthetic device contact present, the flow makes the duplicate risk visible or safely no-ops; a separate save run yields one contact and a truthful saved receipt.

findings.observation: Capture drafts and cancellation are tested, but backgrounding or terminating during the Apple editor and the deferred Session transition is not covered.
findings.evidence: RelationshipCaptureTests cover queued capture and reviewed-draft restoration; the frozen UI journey covers uninterrupted contact cancellation and Session handoff only; artifact-manifest.json lists cross-day return as unavailable.
findings.user_impact: An interrupted recruiter may need to reconstruct whether a contact was saved or which relationship the next Session should use.
findings.recommendation: Exercise background, termination, and next-day return at the contact editor and after capture completion, preserving a truthful pending state rather than guessing the external outcome.
findings.verification: Every interrupted state resumes to the same reviewed Person and relationship, never claims an unverified contact result, and never duplicates the capture or Session draft.

strengths: The screenshot can be opened and zoomed before editable OCR becomes evidence, while the reviewed draft remains intact.
Identity is not preselected, unresolved speaker attribution remains valid, and the screenshot becomes one governed source rather than a duplicate person.
The Session opens on the exact reviewed relationship with an editable objective and no automatic send.
No-action is first class: five Claude live trials recorded no_action instead of manufacturing activity.
missing_evidence: Timed and observed recruiter comparison against the manual fallback.
Background, termination, and cross-day recovery across contact and Session handoff.
open_questions: Do target recruiters want contact creation at capture completion, or only after the first useful Agent recommendation?

reviews.lens: evidence integrity, privacy, and safe action

findings.observation: The prior inspectability gap is resolved: the source card opens a full-screen view and the executable journey double-taps to zoom before returning to editable OCR. A seeded OCR-error correction and source-region-to-edited-text relationship are still not proven.
findings.evidence: source-image-inspection.png and the 33.005-second UI result prove the synthetic original is opened and zoomed before submission; RelationshipCaptureTests prove Vision OCR on a generated image; artifact-manifest.json does not include a seeded wrong-name or wrong-date correction fixture.
findings.user_impact: The recruiter can now materially inspect the source, but a plausible OCR correction is not yet demonstrated end to end or traceable to an image region.
findings.recommendation: Add a low-contrast fixture with one seeded wrong name or date, then preserve enough source-to-edit provenance to show what the reviewer corrected without treating raw OCR as truth.
findings.verification: The source enlarges without losing the draft, the reviewer corrects the seeded error before submission, and the persisted fragment contains reviewed text while retaining the source and review receipt.

findings.observation: Apple's contact editor is the exact authorization gate and cancellation is truthful, but duplicate detection, a successful save receipt, correction, and durable audit or reconciliation are not proven.
findings.evidence: apple-contact-editor-review.png shows only reviewed name and phone in CNContactViewController; contact-cancelled-receipt.png shows no saved contact after Apple's discard confirmation; artifact-manifest.json marks save and duplicate cases not run.
findings.user_impact: A contact can be duplicated or a later user can lack enough product history to reconstruct what was saved.
findings.recommendation: Keep the device-owned boundary explicit, persist a minimal handoff receipt without copying the address book, and test duplicate, saved, cancelled, and permission-change outcomes.
findings.verification: Synthetic device-contact tests yield exactly one contact on save, no contact on cancel or denial, and a receipt whose state matches Contacts readback without ingesting unrelated contacts.

findings.observation: Pending screenshots and drafts now use Complete File Protection and are deleted when advanced, and remote Agent admission rejects non-synthetic evidence; however backup exclusion, derived-store deletion, retention aging, and a private-data Claude provider decision are not verified.
findings.evidence: PendingCaptureInbox.swift writes screenshot, metadata, and draft with completeFileProtection and RelationshipCaptureTests verifies the protection class; agentRuns.ts enforces AGENT_REMOTE_PROVIDER_SYNTHETIC_ONLY; claude-agent-live-runtime.json contains synthetic-only trials.
findings.user_impact: The product cannot truthfully claim that Claude processes private WeChat evidence or that every derived representation is deleted until those lifecycle and provider controls are proven.
findings.recommendation: Keep production private evidence blocked from Claude, define screenshot retention and backup behavior, test deletion across raw image, draft, fragments, Wiki, caches, and receipts, then complete a provider-specific private-data admission review before widening scope.
findings.verification: A deletion inventory test observes no remaining raw or derived capture data after the disclosed boundary, and a separate approved provider-admission gate documents purpose, training, retention, region, access, and incident controls before any private live trial.

strengths: The prior fixed-thumbnail issue is resolved by a full-screen, pinch- and double-tap-zoomable source view exercised in the r7 UI journey.
Speaker attribution begins unresolved, requires an explicit review choice, and candidate Agent proposals remain unavailable until candidate attribution is confirmed.
The raw image stays on device, pending files are protected, and remote Claude execution is synthetic-only.
The Agent manifest contains only read_pursuit, read_evidence, stage_pursuit_proposal, and record_no_action; 30 deterministic and 5 live trials produced zero external effects.
missing_evidence: Seeded OCR correction and source-region-to-reviewed-text provenance.
Successful, denied, duplicate, and reconciled Contacts outcomes.
Backup, retention aging, and deletion proof across every derived capture representation.
Provider-specific approval for private conversation processing; current admission is synthetic-only.
open_questions: Should raw screenshots be excluded from device backup, and what exact retention period should apply to a kept-for-later capture?

reviews.lens: mobile task completion, visual hierarchy, accessibility, and recovery

findings.observation: The prior fixed-thumbnail gap is resolved by a full-card inspect action and a full-screen source that supports pinch and double-tap zoom. The recruiter must return to the review to edit, and no seeded mismatch proves the compare-correct loop under realistic OCR error.
findings.evidence: source-image-inspection.png and the 33.005-second r7 UI journey prove open, double-tap zoom, close, and return to reviewed-ocr-text before submission; no wrong-name or wrong-date correction fixture is frozen.
findings.user_impact: Source content is materially legible now, but repeated source-to-text comparison may still cost attention and a subtle OCR error could remain uncorrected.
findings.recommendation: Test a seeded OCR mismatch on small and large iPhones; if repeated modal switching causes errors, add a comparison treatment that preserves the reviewed draft and reading position.
findings.verification: On small and large iPhones, the seeded mismatch is visible at zoom, corrected without losing text or scroll position, and the submit control follows the source-and-text reading order.

findings.observation: The critical path uses scalable SwiftUI typography and identifiers, but the changed speaker picker, long completion screen, contact handoff, Apple editor transition, cancellation receipt, and scoped Session have not been executed at AX5 or audited with VoiceOver.
findings.evidence: artifact-manifest.json identifies the iPhone 17 Pro default-size executable journey and lists VoiceOver, AX5, small-device, dark-mode, and permission-denied states as not run.
findings.user_impact: Essential identity, authorization, or result context may reorder, clip, or become expensive to navigate for assistive-technology users.
findings.recommendation: Run the changed path at XXXL and AX5, then perform a VoiceOver order audit from source through contact result and Session composer before release approval.
findings.verification: At AX5 no identity, field, consequence, receipt, or recovery action is clipped; VoiceOver announces source and uncertainty before submit, exact contact fields before confirmation, and the unsent Session objective before Send.

findings.observation: Loading, explicit ambiguity, cancellation, retryable Wiki failure, protected draft restore, and unsent Session handoff are covered, but Contacts save, denial, duplicate, background, termination, and client-timeout reconciliation are absent.
findings.evidence: contact-cancelled-receipt.png and scoped-agent-session.png show truthful cancellation and handoff; RelationshipCaptureTests cover draft restoration and Wiki retry; artifact-manifest.json enumerates the untested external and interruption states.
findings.user_impact: The polished happy/cancel path can mask uncertainty about what happens when iOS permissions or lifecycle state changes at the write boundary.
findings.recommendation: Automate the applicable contact and interruption rows from the mobile test matrix and preserve the same reviewed relationship through every recovery path.
findings.verification: All selected matrix rows pass on a small and large supported iPhone with no false success, duplicate contact, lost draft, or wrong Session scope.

strengths: The screenshot source card is now an explicit 44-point-plus action, and the original supports pinch and double-tap zoom with a clear return instruction.
The visual hierarchy is calm and content-led, with one dominant Session action and a separate device-owned contact card.
Apple's native New Contact editor provides predictable exact-field editing and a second discard confirmation.
The final Session visibly preserves Person and relationship context, pre-fills an editable objective, and does not auto-send.
missing_evidence: Small-device, landscape, dark mode, increased contrast, and localization expansion.
AX5 and VoiceOver traversal for the changed path.
Contacts permission, duplicate, save, background, termination, and reconciliation states.
Measured critical-path latency and first-use comprehension.
open_questions: Should the contact handoff remain below the Session action, or should users choose their intended outcome before the long completion page is laid out?

reviews.lens: human connection, trust, agency, communication, collaboration

findings.observation: The recruiter intentionally chooses one screenshot and sees local-storage boundaries, but the reviewed artifact contains no candidate-facing notice, recruiter agreement, or disclosed retention expectation for using private conversation evidence.
findings.evidence: RelationshipCaptureView and relationship-capture-completion.png tell the recruiter that the original stays on device and evidence remains in Talent Signal; artifact-manifest.json contains no candidate notice or consent evidence.
findings.user_impact: A technically safe internal workflow can still surprise a candidate if their private conversation is retained or used beyond the relationship purpose they reasonably expected.
findings.recommendation: Define the recruiter-use agreement and candidate transparency model for intentional capture, including purpose, retention, correction, and deletion, without pretending that every screenshot requires a disruptive consent prompt.
findings.verification: Target recruiters and candidate advisers can accurately explain when capture is appropriate, how a person can request correction or deletion, and what is never sent to a model or external system.

findings.observation: The OCR editor allows manual deletion, but the flow does not actively identify or warn about forwarded, quoted, group-chat, or another candidate's personal data before reviewed text is saved.
findings.evidence: reviewed-ocr-text accepts the full recognized text and the frozen journey uses a one-person synthetic screenshot; artifact-manifest.json does not include TS-ID-03 or TS-ID-04 coverage.
findings.user_impact: Someone who is not the target relationship can have their words or contact details pulled into a person Wiki without context or agency.
findings.recommendation: Add a calm third-party-content check beside evidence review and test forwarded, quoted, and group-chat fixtures that require attribution correction or redaction.
findings.verification: TS-ID-03 and TS-ID-04 fixtures never attribute third-party words to the candidate and never persist unrelated personal data in fragments, Wiki blocks, Agent context, or evaluation logs.

findings.observation: The Session protects human judgment by pre-filling an editable question and sending nothing automatically, but no evaluated Agent answer or real recruiter follow-through demonstrates that the workflow improves listening, candor, or response continuity for the candidate.
findings.evidence: scoped-agent-session.png shows the exact Person, relationship, editable objective, and unsent state; claude-agent-live-runtime.json records five no_action outcomes on synthetic evidence; artifact-manifest.json lists no field study.
findings.user_impact: The product may organize evidence without yet improving the actual next conversation or preventing candidate waiting.
findings.recommendation: Test one evidence-backed next-conversation brief with recruiter and candidate reviewers, measuring whether it produces a specific, candid follow-up rather than more generic messaging.
findings.verification: Reviewed outputs preserve uncertainty, name a human owner and timing only when evidenced, contain no pressure or faux empathy, and improve follow-through in observed recruiter tasks.

strengths: No message, meeting, rejection, reminder, or contact is silently created from the screenshot or Agent output.
The product treats silence and ambiguity as unknown: unresolved attribution is valid and no-action is an observed live outcome.
Relationship context is deliberately kept out of the device contact, reducing surprising personalization or sensitive leakage.
missing_evidence: Candidate transparency, correction, and deletion expectations.
Forwarded, quoted, group-chat, and third-party personal-data fixtures.
Observed recruiter and candidate response to an evidence-backed Agent follow-up brief.
open_questions: What candidate-facing transparency is proportionate for a recruiter-owned relationship memory tool that intentionally avoids automatic outreach?

top_findings.reason: The consequential source, identity, Contacts, cancellation, and Session path has not been executed at AX5 or audited with VoiceOver.
top_findings.next_step: Run the complete r7 path on a small supported iPhone at AX5 and perform a VoiceOver order audit through the unsent Session composer.
top_findings.verification: No critical content or control clips, and VoiceOver announces source, uncertainty, exact contact fields, result state, scope, and unsent status in task order.

top_findings.reason: File Protection and synthetic-only remote admission are proven, but backup, retention, derived deletion, third-party content, and private-data Claude admission remain unverified.
top_findings.next_step: Keep private Claude admission blocked; define and test backup, retention, correction, and deletion across raw and derived data, including group or forwarded content.
top_findings.verification: A disclosed deletion inventory leaves no out-of-scope raw or derived capture data, third-party fixtures are minimized correctly, and private provider use remains impossible until a documented admission gate passes.

top_findings.reason: Apple-owned exact-field review and cancellation are proven, but save, denial, duplicate, interruption, and readback reconciliation are not.
top_findings.next_step: Exercise synthetic Contacts saved, cancelled, denied, pre-existing duplicate, background, and termination states with minimal truthful receipts.
top_findings.verification: Each scenario produces exactly the verified device state, never duplicates a contact, never claims unknown success, and preserves the reviewed Person and relationship scope.

agreements: The original screenshot remains device-owned, protected with Complete File Protection while pending, and can be opened and zoomed before editable OCR is submitted.
Speaker attribution starts unresolved, unresolved remains a valid outcome, and identity is never preselected or inferred into confirmed state.
The contact card contains only reviewed contact fields and opens Apple's editor as the exact human authorization boundary; cancellation truthfully records no write.
The Session is scoped to the reviewed Person and relationship, pre-fills an editable objective, and does not auto-send.
Claude Agent SDK execution is constrained to four governed tools; 30 deterministic and 5 live synthetic trials produced zero external effects, with no_action observed in all live trials.

disagreements.issue: Whether device-contact handoff belongs at capture completion or after the first useful Agent recommendation

positions.position: The timing is unproven and may add capture burden before the recruiter has received enough value.
positions.evidence: No timed recruiter comparison or field observation exists for the completion surface.

positions.position: The current optional, device-owned card is visually separate and safe, but the long completion page leaves outcome prioritization uncertain.
positions.evidence: relationship-capture-completion.png and the passing UI journey show separate Session and Contacts actions without silent execution.

disagreements.resolution: Keep the handoff optional and unchanged for this slice; use a discriminating recruiter test before moving, promoting, or delaying it.
disagreements.resolution_basis: The current implementation is reversible and safely gated, while only field evidence can determine the lower-interruption timing.

adjudication.rationale: This is a credible, evidence-first basic slice, not an honest 99-point release claim. The executable path proves local source handling, explicit identity, canonical Wiki creation, a human-gated Contacts preview/cancel flow, exact unsent Session handoff, and a four-tool Claude control plane. No specialist issued a veto, so the artifact can pass with changes. Release remains needs_evidence because accessibility, full Contacts reconciliation, lifecycle/deletion and private-provider admission, third-party content, and observed recruiter/candidate value are not yet proven.

next_tests.test: Run r7 on the smallest supported iPhone at AX5, then audit VoiceOver order and dark/increased-contrast rendering from source inspection through Session.
next_tests.evidence_required: Passing UI recordings or screenshots, accessibility hierarchy/order notes, and zero clipped or unreachable consequential controls.
next_tests.pass_condition: The complete path is operable without sight or default text size, and every uncertainty, field, consequence, receipt, scope, and unsent state is announced in task order.

next_tests.test: Run Contacts save, denial, duplicate, background, termination, and readback reconciliation; run raw-and-derived capture deletion plus forwarded/group-chat minimization fixtures.
next_tests.evidence_required: Synthetic Contacts readback, minimal handoff receipts, storage inventory before and after deletion, and TS-ID-03/TS-ID-04 persistence and log inspection.
next_tests.pass_condition: Exactly one intended contact exists only after save, no false success occurs, recovery stays in scope, deletion removes disclosed data, and third-party content is neither misattributed nor retained out of purpose.

next_tests.test: Compare the r7 flow with a manual note-plus-Contacts fallback using at least five independent recruiters, then review one evidence-backed follow-up brief with candidate advisers.
next_tests.evidence_required: Task timing, corrections, abandonment, comprehension, useful-next-action notes, and candidate trust feedback using the same frozen ambiguity fixture.
next_tests.pass_condition: The Talent Signal path catches the seeded ambiguity without worse median completion or abandonment, recruiters can name the next action, and candidate reviewers find the follow-up candid, specific, non-pressuring, and correctable.
